lore2980_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere generous warmth, easy confidence, amused promise] I would be glad to come along. You seem to remember there are people at the end of the road who need what we bring back. That matters to me. And if we find a good meal, I promise to divide the last spoonful fairly.
lore2980_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would be glad to come along. You seem to remember there are people at the end of the road who need what we bring back. That matters to me. And if we find a good meal, I promise to divide the last spoonful fairly.

lore2980_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep hearty welcome, practical warmth, lightly conspiratorial at the end] Welcome, friend. What has the day brought you? A useful hunt, I hope, or at least a story we can enjoy over a meal. I have been keeping an eye on the stew pot. There may yet be something worth sharing at the bottom.
lore2980_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, friend. What has the day brought you? A useful hunt, I hope, or at least a story we can enjoy over a meal. I have been keeping an eye on the stew pot. There may yet be something worth sharing at the bottom.

lore2980_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rich grounded conviction, warm humor, quietly pleased] You can keep the grand trophy. Give me a good hide, meat for the pot, and something useful to carry home. Those are things the camp will remember when the boasting is over. Though I admit I am especially attentive when the pot is nearly empty.
lore2980_idle_1.ogg.text: You can keep the grand trophy. Give me a good hide, meat for the pot, and something useful to carry home. Those are things the camp will remember when the boasting is over. Though I admit I am especially attentive when the pot is nearly empty.

lore2980_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [deep proud approval, thoughtful, warmly encouraging] Good work. Think of what those supplies will become. A meal, a mended shelter, clothing that keeps someone warm. It is easy to see only the hunt while you are out there. I like to remember what happens after we carry it home.
lore2980_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. Think of what those supplies will become. A meal, a mended shelter, clothing that keeps someone warm. It is easy to see only the hunt while you are out there. I like to remember what happens after we carry it home.

lore2981_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere pleasure, generous grounded warmth] I would welcome a walk with you. There is much we can notice when we give ourselves time. Tell me where your path has taken you, and what you have found worth remembering. I am glad to share a little of the journey.
lore2981_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome a walk with you. There is much we can notice when we give ourselves time. Tell me where your path has taken you, and what you have found worth remembering. I am glad to share a little of the journey.

lore2981_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep resonant warmth, patient grounded welcome] Welcome, my friend. Sit with me a moment. I have been working on a small carving between other duties. A leaf, nothing elaborate. There is pleasure in letting a simple shape take its time. Tell me how your own work has been going.
lore2981_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. Sit with me a moment. I have been working on a small carving between other duties. A leaf, nothing elaborate. There is pleasure in letting a simple shape take its time. Tell me how your own work has been going.

lore2981_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [earthy thoughtful satisfaction, gentle warmth, measured] This little leaf came from a scrap I had set aside. I found I liked working at the curve in quiet moments. One edge is still uneven. I may leave it that way. It rests pleasantly in my hand, and that is reason enough to enjoy it.
lore2981_idle_1.ogg.text: This little leaf came from a scrap I had set aside. I found I liked working at the curve in quiet moments. One edge is still uneven. I may leave it that way. It rests pleasantly in my hand, and that is reason enough to enjoy it.

lore2981_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [calm elder encouragement, thoughtful, warmly practical] A new lesson. Give it care before you measure yourself by how quickly you master it. Even a small carving asks the hand to learn. With patience, the next attempt may teach you something the first one could not.
lore2981_learned_1.ogg.text: A new lesson. Give it care before you measure yourself by how quickly you master it. Even a small carving asks the hand to learn. With patience, the next attempt may teach you something the first one could not.

lore2982_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere affection, patient warmth, quietly teasing] I would welcome your company. We can speak of what you have learned, or find something pleasant to notice along the path. A friend need not bring a test to every meeting. I will even spare you my worst rhyme, unless you ask to hear it.
lore2982_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company. We can speak of what you have learned, or find something pleasant to notice along the path. A friend need not bring a test to every meeting. I will even spare you my worst rhyme, unless you ask to hear it.

lore2982_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep composed welcome, attentive, a restrained playful smile] Welcome. You have come with something on your mind. Speak, and I will listen. If you catch me pausing afterward, do not assume the answer is a mystery. I may simply be trying to stop a very poor rhyme from escaping into the conversation.
lore2982_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome. You have come with something on your mind. Speak, and I will listen. If you catch me pausing afterward, do not assume the answer is a mystery. I may simply be trying to stop a very poor rhyme from escaping into the conversation.

lore2982_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [low resonant voice, dry mischievous humor, gentle amusement] Bristleback. Whistle back. Yes, I know. There must be a better use for those words than the one I have found. You need not look so solemn. I am allowed to enjoy a foolish rhyme without declaring it part of the rites.
lore2982_idle_1.ogg.text: Bristleback. Whistle back. Yes, I know. There must be a better use for those words than the one I have found. You need not look so solemn. I am allowed to enjoy a foolish rhyme without declaring it part of the rites.

lore2982_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [calm thoughtful instruction, firm kindness, encouraging] A new lesson asks something of you beyond remembering its words. Try it with care, and notice where your understanding holds. There is no shame in a question. I would rather hear one honest uncertainty than watch someone mistake a proud face for wisdom.
lore2982_learned_1.ogg.text: A new lesson asks something of you beyond remembering its words. Try it with care, and notice where your understanding holds. There is no shame in a question. I would rather hear one honest uncertainty than watch someone mistake a proud face for wisdom.

lore3061_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [steady sincere friendliness, generous, an easy smile] I would enjoy walking with you. Tell me what you see, and we can compare our observations. There is always something I might have missed. And if you hear a poor attempt at a bird call, remember that everyone needs practice at something.
lore3061_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would enjoy walking with you. Tell me what you see, and we can compare our observations. There is always something I might have missed. And if you hear a poor attempt at a bird call, remember that everyone needs practice at something.

lore3061_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [deep attentive welcome, practical warmth, self-deprecating amusement] Welcome. What have you noticed today? There is more to learning the plains than remembering where to aim. I have been listening to a bird near camp. It answers my whistle now and then. Whether that means I am improving is another question entirely.
lore3061_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome. What have you noticed today? There is more to learning the plains than remembering where to aim. I have been listening to a bird near camp. It answers my whistle now and then. Whether that means I am improving is another question entirely.

lore3061_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [rich relaxed voice, thoughtful humor, quietly amused] The bird makes it sound so easy. One little call, clear as anything. Mine needs work. I think it answered that last attempt, though I cannot say whether it approved. It is useful for a teacher to remember what being a beginner feels like.
lore3061_idle_1.ogg.text: The bird makes it sound so easy. One little call, clear as anything. Mine needs work. I think it answered that last attempt, though I cannot say whether it approved. It is useful for a teacher to remember what being a beginner feels like.

lore3061_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm encouraging teacher, grounded warmth, gently humorous] Good. Try it carefully before deciding you have mastered it. Watch what changes when you slow down. One successful attempt is worth enjoying, and the next one is worth your full attention. That applies to a fine shot, or to a very stubborn whistle.
lore3061_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Try it carefully before deciding you have mastered it. Watch what changes when you slow down. One successful attempt is worth enjoying, and the next one is worth your full attention. That applies to a fine shot, or to a very stubborn whistle.
